title: Miss Punch Entry
text:
Miss Punch Entry 
 Help > Transaction > Attendance" />
 Miss Punch 
 Entry 
 Missed 
 punch request can be raised by an employee in case they missed their in/out 
 punch or both punches. Reporting authorities have rights to approve/reject 
 those missed punch requests and attendance would get marked accordingly. 
 Payroll 
 > Attendance > Missed Punch Entry 
 Select 
 “Leave year” and the “Month Name” of when the missed punch happened. List 
 of employees who have missed their punch will appear here. 
 Then 
 the “In time”, “Out time” and “Remarks” can be modified. 
 Leave Year : Select “Leave year”. 
 Month Name : Select the “Month Name” 
 of when the missed punch happened. 
 List 
 of employees who have missed their punch will appear in the datagrid. 
 Then 
 the data in “In time”, “Out time” and “Remarks” columns can be modified. 
 After saving missed punch entry in Payroll, 
 the updated timing entry will be reflected in the Processed Attendance 
 menu. 
 Employee Portal > 
 Attendance 
 > Missed Punch Entry 
 An employee can create 
 a missed punch entry through the same process from their Employee Portal. 
 It has to go for approval according to the approval workflow. In this 
 case, it is only after approvals will the updated timing be reflected 
 in his Processed Attendance menu. 
 Mobile Application 
 > Missed 
 Punch Entry 
 Employees have the convenience 
 of rectifying missed punch entries via the mobile application using a 
 straightforward process. If any relevant business rules apply, the entry 
 may require approval. Once approved, the biometric system will seamlessly 
 update to reflect the corrected punch entry. 
 Reports 
 Reporting of Missed punch entries 
 can be found in Reports > Attendance Related > Missed Punch Report. 
 This report only displays missed punch entries in the system according 
 to the parameters chosen. 
 Other reports which contain 
 brief information about Missed Punches are Daily Attendance Register, 
 Biometric Attendance Register and Monthly Attendance Register. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Leave Management System
text:
Leave Management System 
 Help > Transaction > Attendance" />
 Leave Management 
 System 
 Leave is a period or duration when an employee do 
 not attend his duty for certain reason. This duration can be of Quarter 
 day or Half day or Full day depending on the nature of requirement. Leaves 
 are subject to application to reporting manager whose validity can be 
 dependent on prior or later approval depending on nature of Leave and 
 policy of the organization. 
 Leave duration is dependent on nature wise number 
 of leaves allotted to individual employee for the Leave year. Leaves are 
 different from Calendar Holidays and off days which are common to group 
 of employees of an office location and are pre-scheduled. During Holidays 
 and Off-days, organization remains close but Leaves are no duty period 
 for the applied employees only. 
 Leave Setup 
 Leave Year is the period during which leave calculation 
 and maintenance of each employee is done. Leave lapses, carry-forwards, 
 encasements, periodic accrual, etc., are all dependent on pre-defined 
 Leave year as per policy of the organization. 
 Creation of 
 Leave Year 
 Leave year is auto created by the system from Fiscal 
 Year Generation option available in administration module. The Fiscal 
 Year Generation is based on setup as defined in Fiscal Year Template also 
 available in administration module. 
 Fiscal Year 
 Template 
 Fiscal Year Templates are created on the basis of 
 five fixed Year Types like Accounting, Leave, PF, ESI and Bonus. The period 
 type selected here are either annually and Half Yearly. Here for each 
 Year Type the start Month and End Month are predefined on the basis of 
 requirement of the organization. 
 Leave year period is generally for the full year 
 so Period Type is selected as annually. If there is any specific requirement 
 where Leave year is maintained for Six months period then only Period 
 Type is selected as Half Yearly. 
 In case of Leave year period is on yearly basis 
 the Year Type is selected as annually. Accordingly the Start month and 
 end month of the Leave year is specified in the template. On the basis 
 of Leave policy of the organization the Start and End month of the Leave 
 year can on Calendar year basis Viz. from January to December or on financial 
 year basis like April to March. If the Financial year of the organization 
 is January to December or July to June as per general norms of the country 
 where the organization belongs to then the Leave year may follow the same 
 period. 
 Thus the Leave year can be same as Financial Year 
 or different as per requirement. When Leave year period is on Six months 
 basis the Year Type is selected as Half Yearly. Accordingly the Start 
 month and end month of the Leave year needs to be specified twice for 
 a year in the template. Thus the Month period of Leave year on half yearly 
 basis can January to June and July to December or April to September and 
 October to March as per requirement of year period. Leave year can have 
 a Cut off Start Date and accordingly have a End date on the end of the 
 period. This option is rarely used only if there is any specific requirement. 
 Fiscal Year 
 Generation 
 On the basis of selected Year Type like Accounting, 
 Leave, PF, ESI and Bonus the Year Start Date and Year End Date are generated 
 based on pre defined setup in Fiscal Year Template. Accordingly Leave 
 year is generated automatically by running the Generation option every 
 year with respective Start and End Date as per setup defined in the template. 
 Leave Master 
 To incorporate Leave management system in an organization, 
 the first step is to configure the available leave heads through Leave 
 master screen. All the configurable factors of each leave head are described 
 as follows. 
 Main Info 
 Code : Leave Code or short name 
 Description : Name of Leave 
 Leave Type : 
 Users can create leave names as per individual choice but the nature of 
 leave is determined by leave type selected from the specified list. 
 Example: If Leave Type is selected as Sick Leave 
 then attachment can be made mandatory with leave application. Similarly 
 if leave type is selected as Casual Leave then maximum 2 days can be allowed 
 in an application. 
 Available 
 options are as follows: [Normal, Sick Leave, 
 Casual Leave, Earn Leave, Maternity Leave, Voting, Restricted Holiday, 
 Paid Leave, Unpaid Leave, Compensatory Leave] 
 Opening Value : 
 If any opening leave value is specified then when a new Leave Year is 
 created, employee wise specified leave value is added to individual leave 
 heads and this value shows as opening balance. 
 Example: If 20 is specified as 
 Opening Value for leave head EL before creation of new leave year, then 
 for each employee EL opening value will be 20 for that Leave Year when 
 it is created. 
 Round Off Type : Leave balance can 
 be rounded off as per specified setup. 
 Example: Nearest 1 means leave 
 balance of 7.4 will be considered as 7 but 7.5 will be considered as 8. 
 Similarly in case of next 1 leave balance of 7.2 will be considered as 
 8. 
 Available options are as follows: [No 
 Rounding Off, Nearest 1, Next 1, Custom] 
 Leave Approve : Months after joining 
 leave application can be done. 
 Available options are as follows: [1, 2, 3. etc.] 
 Previous Allow Days : Days up to 
 which back dated leave application can be done. 
 Available options are as follows: [1, 
 2, 3, etc.] 
 Max Leave Taken : Monthly maximum 
 leave limit can be set. 
 Show in Payslip : If this option 
 is checked then the current Leave balance will be shown in Payslip. 
 Leave Carry Forward 
 Carry Forward Applicable : 
 If this option is checked then Leave balance of last year will be carried 
 forward to subsequent year as opening balance. 
 Example: Closing balance of EL for the leave year 
 2019-20 will be carried forward as Opening balance 
 of EL for the leave year 2020-21. 
 Limit (In Days) : 
 Maximum number of leaves that can be carried forward for each leave head 
 to next leave year. 
 Example: Suppose EL balance 
 of an employee is 73 but as per limit days it is set as 60, so 60 days 
 EL balance will be carried forward and rest 13 days will lapse. 
 Is Different Carry 
 Forward Head : Closing balance of a leave head can be carried forward 
 to another specified leave head in subsequent leave year. 
 Carry Forward Head : 
 Leave head where closing balance of last year is updated as opening balance 
 of subsequent leave year. 
 Example: Leave balance of EL is carried forward 
 the EL LY (EL Last Year) in subsequent leave year. 
 Leave Encashment 
 Payable Head : Earring head where 
 the calculated value of Leave Encashment will be stored. 
 Minimum Days : Leave balance below 
 which balance cannot be encashed. 
 Maximum Days : Maximum leave balance 
 days upto which it can be encashed. 
 Max Encash No : No. of time encashment 
 can be done. 
 Late Deduction 
 Is Late Applicable : If this option 
 is checked then there can be deduction of Leave against late days. 
 Late Days : Number of late days for 
 which Leave balance will be deducted. 
 Deduct Value : Number of Leaves that 
 will be deducted against specified number of late days. 
 Sequence No : Sequence of Leave head 
 which will be considered for deduction. 
 Is LWP Deduct : If this option is 
 checked then there will be LWP in case of no leave balance. 
 Example: If Late days is mentioned in attendance 
 and Leave deduction against late is applicable then based on specified 
 Late days, say 3 lates, may deduct 1 Leave day on the basis of specified 
 Leave head sequence. On every 3 lates, 1 EL gets deducted. If there is 
 no EL balance then SL will be deducted as per Leave head sequence. In 
 case of no EL and SL balance 1 CL balance will be deducted. In case of 
 no EL, no SL and no CL, employee can be marked as 1 day absent. 
 Increment 
 Leave increment is adding of specified number of 
 leaves each month once monthly attendance is saved. This increment may 
 be on prorate basis on salary days or on fixed basis. 
 Increment Type : 
 Leave increment process can be implemented by this option. Leave Increment 
 option is generally based on attendance of the month. 
 Leave increment is based on specified number of 
 days after every specified period. In case of slab based increment, a 
 predefined slab or range wise number of leaves that will be added against 
 specified attendance days. 
 Available options are as follows: 
 [Period Wise Increment, Slab Based Increment] 
 Example: Period wise Increment means increment of 
 2 days on monthly basis. In case of slab based increment the system will 
 check the specified slab and then put the increment days on the basis 
 of this slab. 
 Increment Duration : Period of increment 
 can be on specified period like monthly, quarterly, etc. 
 Available options are as follows: 
 [Monthly, Quarterly] 
 Increment Days : Number of Leaves 
 that will be added to existing leave balance. 
 For Confirmed Employees : Leave increment 
 can be made applicable for confirmed employees only. 
 Consider For Attendance : Increment 
 calculation is based on attendance. 
 Example: 1.5 leaves per month increment on prorata 
 salary days. If salary days in 20 then monthly increment will be (1.5 
 * 20) /30 = 2.25 in a 30 days month. 
 Minimum Present 
 Days : Minimum present days below which Leave days increment will 
 not happen. 
 Minimum Increment 
 Days : Minimum increment days can be specified below which leave 
 increment value will be zero. 
 Calculation Basis : Basis of Increment 
 day calculation. 
 Available 
 options are as follows: 
 [Prorata 
 on Present Days, Fixed Leave, Fixed on Salary Days] 
 Increment Start Month : Number of 
 months after joining when Leave increment starts. 
 Available 
 options are as follows: 
 [1, 
 2, 3, etc.] 
 Maximum Monthly 
 Balance : This is required where maximum monthly leave balance is 
 maintained. To maintain this monthly increment can be restricted if the 
 monthly count exceeds. 
 Maximum Yearly Balance : 
 For Joining Cutoff : Dependent on 
 date of joining Leave increment will be applicable. 
 Example: 
 Employee joining after 15th of any month will not have any leave increment. 
 Cutoff Day : Leave cutoff date on 
 any month. 
 Example: Leaves taken after 25th of any month will 
 be considered for next month. Accordingly calendar showing in Leave application 
 will show 26th of previous month to 25th of current month. 
 Extra Info 
 Negative Leave : 
 If the employee does not have leave balance but in case Negative Leave 
 is made applicable then the employee can apply for Leave even if there 
 is no Leave balance. 
 Negative Leave Limit : The applicability 
 of negative leave is subject to set limit days. 
 Exclude Holiday 
 Off-day : Leave application before and after of Holiday and/or Off-day 
 will be included or excluded based on this setup. 
 Example: Any leave application starting from Friday 
 to Monday will be of 2 days or 4 days where Saturday and Sunday being 
 weekly off. 
 Consider Absent : If the is any absent 
 day in between to leaves the leave to be allowed or not. 
 Leave without Pay : 
 Leave head against which leave taken days are not payable is called Leave 
 without pay. 
 Example: There are Organizations where any absence 
 from duty whether the employee is having Leave balance or not needs to 
 allow only through proper application and approval. In such case a special 
 leave head can be created with tagged as Leave without Pay. Any such application 
 will be add absent days in monthly attendance. 
 Document Attachment : 
 If this option is checked then attachment of document is mandatory against 
 the leave application. 
 Example: 
 In case of Sick Leave, attachment of medical certificate can be made mandatory 
 by this option. 
 Leave 
 Opening 
 Each employee has an opening leave balance for 
 respective leave heads except the leave heads which are accrued on periodic 
 basis. Employee can take leave from the available balance until the balance 
 becomes zero. Once the leaves are availed the balance gets reduced on 
 equal numbers. 
 Leave opening 
 balances are subject to Leave Year. Each Leave Year will have respective 
 leave opening for respective leave head and employee. On the start of 
 a Leave year Leave opening balance and Leave Closing balance are same 
 but as the employee avails the leaves during the year, the Closing balance 
 reduces accordingly but the Leave Opening balance remains same throughout 
 the year. Employee can avail as many leaves as per available in the Leave 
 Closing balance subject to leave policy of the organization. 
 Example: 
 Date: 
 Leave Head 
 Availed 
 Opening Balance 
 Closing Balance 
 01/01/2020

 As per Leave 
 policy of the organization, closing balance of leave of previous year 
 can be carrier forward as opening balance in subsequent leave year for 
 the same leave head of the employee. There can be a predefined limit days 
 upto which leave balance can be carried forward and the remaining balance 
 can lapse. 
 Leave Carry Forward 
 Leave closing balance of previous year can be carried 
 forward as opening balance of new leave year if the same is allowed in 
 Leave policy of the organization. If there is any specified limit days 
 then leave balance will be carried forward upto that extent and remaining 
 balance will lapse. The option of carry forward with its limit days is 
 specified in Leave Master for individual leave head. 
 Example: 
 Limit Days: 15 
 Yearly Increment: 18

 Employee Leave 
 Employee can apply for leave during the leave year 
 for as many days and times as permitted in the Leave policy. These applications 
 are generally subject to approval by as many levels of approvers as specified 
 in the setup depending on approval hierarchy. 
 In each leave application following information 
 needs to be specified. 
 Employee : Name of the applicant. 
 Leave year: Leave Year to be selected. 
 Month Name : Month for which leave 
 is availed. 
 Leave Head : Applied Leave head to 
 be selected. 
 Opening Balance : Leave Opening balance 
 of the specified employee is displayed by the system. 
 Current Balance : Current Leave balance 
 of the specified employee is displayed by the system. 
 Application Date : Date of leave 
 application. 
 Day Type : Either Half Day or Full 
 Day can be selected as per requirement. 
 Available options are: [Half 
 Day/Full Day] 
 Period Type : 
 If Day Type is selected as Half Day then either First Half or Second Half 
 can be specified. If Day Type is selected as Full day then Period Type 
 option is not displayed. 
 Available options are: [First 
 Half/Second Half] 
 Application 
 From 
 Date: Applied from Leave Date 
 To 
 Date: Applied to Leave Date. In case of one day leave From Date and To 
 Date will be same. 
 Purpose: Purpose of Leave taken 
 needs to be specified here. 
 Remarks: 
 Any other related remarks can be specified here. 
 Grant 
 Granted: 
 If the leave is granted then this Check Box is ticked. 
 Granted 
 From: Granted from date. 
 Granted To: Granted to date. The granted to date 
 can be less than application to date if less number of days is granted. 
 Days Granted: The number of days between Granted 
 from and Granted to is auto calculated and displayed here. 
 Attachment 
 Soft copy of manual Leave Application or any other 
 document/Certificate can be attached with leave application. 
 Example: In case of Sick Leave, attachment of medical 
 certificate may be mandatory as per leave policy to avail the leave. These 
 attachments can be viewed or downloaded later. 
 Approval History 
 Leave 
 approval history can be viewed at any time and pending status can be checked. 
 Compensatory Leave 
 There may be situation when an employee had to attend 
 his duty on any Holiday or Off day due to some essential work of the organization. 
 As the employee attends office on these days his off day/holiday is compensated 
 on another day by increasing his leave balance. This increase in leave 
 balance can be done on any particular leave head as per policy or a separate 
 leave head may be created as Compensatory Leave and adjusted on it by 
 adding to the closing balance. 
 Compensatory Leave can be used to adjust leave closing 
 balance of any employee on any leave head which may be required if there 
 is a mistake in opening balance or any approved leave needs to be reverted 
 back. Leave adjustment entry can be passed for both adding in Closing 
 balance or reduction Closing balance as the requirement may be. This can 
 be done by entering Adjust value in positive or negative. 
 Employee : Name of employee whose 
 compensatory leave needs to be specified. 
 Leave Year : Selection of Leave year 
 Month Name : Month name for which 
 compensatory leave needs to be entered. 
 Leave Head : Leave head which is 
 compensated due to extra duty. 
 Opening Balance : Display of leave 
 opening balance for the selected leave head. 
 Current Balance : Display of leave 
 current balance for the selected leave head. 
 Application Date : Date of application. 
 Adjust Value : Number of days that 
 needs to be compensated. 
 Remarks : Details with reason for 
 the compensation of leave balance.

 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Advance
text:
Advance 
 Help > Transaction > Advance" />
 Tutorial: Creating 
 Employee Advance 
 Advance 
 Advance payment can be given 
 against salary and it has to be deducted against future salary. The deduction 
 can be made in one or more installments. The deduction will start taking 
 place from the month specified. Salary will be automatically deducted 
 as per schedule defined and will reflect in the payslip. If Payment Requisition 
 has been enabled then a payment request will be sent to the finance module. 
 Advance can also be applied through Employee Self Service Portal and Farvision 
 Pay Mobile Application. It is highly recommended that approvals be activated 
 for advances which are made through payroll 
 mobile app and employee 
 portal . 
 Adjustments or variations in 
 deduction amount or deduction schedule or waiver (in part or full) of 
 advance amount are handled through the Adjustment screen. 
 Configurations of policies 
 for giving advance can be done through 
 Advance Setup 
 Advance 
 policy can be mapped at Enterprise or Company Level. 
 Time 
 period after which an employee is eligible for getting an advance. 
 Allow 
 multiple advances at a time. 
 Set 
 limit based on Monthly CTC, Monthly Gross or manual amount with ceiling 
 percentage 
 Employee : 
 Select the employee who requires advance against salary. 
 Deduction 
 Head : By default, the deduction head which is created through Deduction Master 
 will be displayed here. The deduction head Identification should always 
 be Advance. 
 Advance 
 Date : Select the date on which the advance is being applied for. 
 Deduction 
 Month : Select the month from which the deduction against the advance 
 will start. This can be any month for which salary has not been generated. 
 If salary has been generated for the month, the deduction cannot start 
 from that month. Example, advance date is 1 Sep, deduction month can be 
 September or even August if the salary for August has not been generated. 
 Advance 
 Type : Select the type of advance as Normal. 
 Deduction 
 Type : Deduction can either be made in installments or as a lump 
 sum amount. 
 Advance 
 Amount : Enter the amount of advance being taken. 
 Balance 
 Amount : Any deductions already made will be automatically adjusted 
 and the balance amount against the advance is displayed here. If no amount 
 has been deducted, it will show the full advance amount here. 
 No. 
 of Installment : If installment has been selected, enter the number 
 of installments in which the amount will be deducted. 
 Deduction 
 Amount : In case deduction type is amount, the advance amount mentioned 
 above is the deduction amount. In case the deduction type is installments, 
 the advance amount is divided by the number of installments and displayed 
 here. The remainder or balance of any amount left is deducted additionally 
 after the installment amounts are paid. 
 Remarks : 
 Enter remarks of advance if any 
 Close : 
 This is auto closed when the entire advance amount has been deducted from 
 payroll. This working is on the basis of the salary generation process, 
 not on the payout of salary. 
 Payment 
 Info : History of amount paid through salary deductions and balance 
 amount is displayed here. Impact of variations in payment schedule or 
 amount done through the Adjustment interface will also be displayed here. 
 Only waivers given will be reflected with Payment type as Adjustment. 
 More info is available in Adjustment. 
 In this example, 
 an advance of Rs 20000 was taken in April, deduction started from salary 
 of April. In June, no advance was deducted. From July the installment 
 amount was increased to 4000. In September, waiver of Rs 8000 was given. 
 Payment Requisition 
 for Employee Advance allows the advance amount to be sent to the Finance 
 module as a request for payment. The request will be displayed in the 
 PRQ Generation screen. If the Finance module is being used, this should 
 be enabled. Payment Requisition for Employee Advance is enabled in the 
 Payment Requisition Setup. 
 If it is enabled 
 and the Finance module is not in use, then advance deduction entry will 
 not be visible in the payslip or any other payroll interfaces until this 
 requisition is processed through the Finance module. 
 If there is a 
 negative adjustment, for example in case of waivers, and Payment requisition 
 for Employee Advance is enabled, then automatically a Salary Journal entry 
 will be done which allows for the impact of waiver through Advance Adjustment 
 to be given in Finance module. In case Payment Requisition for Employee 
 Advance is not enabled then the waiver amount will not be visible in finance. 
 The finance module will show payment receivable against advance from the 
 employee and the payroll module will show no receivable against advance 
 from the employee as it has been waived off. 
 PRQ 
 generation screen 
 Advance 
 Adjustment 
 Salary 
 Journal 
 Posting : PRQ 
 generation, Journal and Payment entries will always be posted in Salary 
 Business Unit through Organisation 
 Master . 
 Usage in Reports: 
 1. 
 Advance Register 
 2. 
 Pay Register 
 Tutorial: Creating Employee Advance 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Special Concession
text:
Special Concession 
 Help > Transaction > Attendance" />
 Special 
 Concession 
 This feature 
 allows special concessions for employees regarding ‘Late 
 Coming’ or ‘Early Leaving’ under special circumstances. Concessions 
 can be granted to a single employee 
 or applied to all employees 
 as needed. 
 Example: 
 For a doctor’s appointment, such an exception can be provided to a particular 
 employee. In the case of very heavy rainfall, such an exception can be 
 applied to all employees. 
 Steps to be followed: 
 At 
 first, navigate to Payroll 
 > Attendance > Special Concession 
 Select 
 the ‘Month’ and ‘Punch 
 Date’ for which concession is to be provided 
 B ased on the Month and date, display 
 only those 
 employee data with 
 Late or Early . 
 Select 
 concession type as ‘Late 
 Coming’ or ‘Early Going’ 
 Enter 
 Remarks as appropriate 
 Filter 
 employees based 
 on ‘Seating Office’ or ‘Business Unit’ 
 Select 
 relevant Seating office name 
 or Business unit name . 
 For 
 a particular employee or employees, provide adjust time for each employee. 
 If the concession is ‘applied to 
 all’ employees, provide adjusted time to be applied to all. 
 Incase 
 'Apply To All ' checkbox is 
 ticked, the Adjust Time field 
 should display the time to be applied to all the data existing in 
 the grid. 
 Note: To put a 'Colon' between 
 the hours and minutes, such as 10:15, the 
 system accepts a 'fullstop ' as shown in the image below.

 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Adjustment
text:
Adjustment 
 Help > Transaction > Advance" />
 Tutorial: 
 Creating Advance Adjustment 
 Adjustment 
 Changes to 
 existing advance taken can be done through this Adjustment screen. 
 1. Monthly Installment amount can be altered for 
 specified month 
 2. Monthly 
 Installment amount can be altered from a specified month and onwards 
 3. Balance 
 can be partly or fully closed from a specified month. i.e. waived off 
 For Payroll 
 to Finance Module posting, Payment requisition of Advance should be enabled 
 for negative value in the advance adjustment amount which will reflect 
 in the Advance Adjustment in Salary Journal. 
 For a positive 
 value in the advance adjustment amount, a new advance amount should be 
 taken from the Advance screen, so if a Payment requisition is enabled 
 then it will go through the PRQ Generation. 
 Advance Taken Entry

 adjustment needs to be selected. 
 Here Employee 
 Code, Employee Name, Advance Date, Advance amount and Outstanding balance 
 are shown for selection of required Employee and Advance. 
 Adjustment 
 Type : Amount or Installment can be selected. 
 If the installment 
 amount is required to be changed then 'Adjustment Type' should be selected 
 as Adjustment. 
 Month 
 Period : The Month Year to be selected from which adjustment will 
 take effect. 
 Effective 
 Date : The Date to be selected from which adjustment will take effect. 
 Adjustment 
 Amount : The amount which requires to be adjusted is to be entered 
 here. 
 Example: 
 Advance

 MR. 
 X has taken an Advance of Rs20,000 in the month of April 2021. His monthly 
 installment is set as Rs. 2000 for next 10 months. His repayment process 
 also starts from April 2021. 
 First 
 2 months he repaid Rs. 2000 per month which means he repaid Rs. 4,000. 
 In 
 the June 2021 month the employee requested a skip of installment repayment 
 so an adjustment entry was passed making the installment amount to 0. 
 In 
 the 4th month i.e. July 2021, his installment amount was altered to Rs. 
 4,000 and this adjustment was continued for next 4 months. 
 In 
 6th month i.e. September 2021, on the basis of Approval from management 
 the balance amount of Rs. 8,000 is waived off by passing another adjustment 
 entry. For this the Adjustment Type is selected as Amount and Adjustment 
 Amount needs to be specified as -8000. So the outstanding balance is changed 
 to 0 and the Advance is closed. If the payment requisition is not enabled 
 then the advance adjustment entry will go only in Payroll Module effect. 
 If the effect is required in the Finance Module then payment requisition 
 should be enabled and after passing the adjustment amount then this amount 
 will be available in Advance Adjustment in Salary Journal.

title: Leave Encashment
text:
Leave Encashment 
 Help > Transaction > Advance" />
 Leave Encashment 
 "Leave 
 encashment" refers to the compensation or payment made in return 
 for unused leaves. HR can issue encashments for an employee. This can 
 be done during the employment, or while retiring, as per the organization's 
 policy. 
 Any 
 leave encashment is taxable as it is considered as income from salary. 
 In this case, the employee can get tax relief under Section 89. As per 
 Section 89, the employee can claim tax relief from the amount received 
 through the leave encashment process. 
 Step by Step Process 
 Setup Menu 
 1. Creation 
 of Earning Head: 
 Identification 
 = LEAVE EN-CASHMENT 
 Method 
 = Any except “Reimbursement” 
 Reimbursement 
 Checkbox should not be checked 
 CTC 
 applicable = defines whether it is a part of the employee’s CTC or not 
 2 . Creation 
 of Paystructure Definition: 
 Earnings 
 will be varies depending on the Formula 
 3 . CTC 
 Creation: 
 Leave 
 Encashment head should be checked in CTC 
 4 . Enacashable Leave Head Setup : 
 Encash Applicable 
 checkbox 
 should be checked for Leave Encash process 
 Payable Head 
 refers 
 to the Leave head under which leave encashment is applicable 
 Minimum Days 
 refers 
 to the minimum days required in that leave head for leave encashment for 
 a single entry 
 Maximum Days 
 refers 
 to the maximum days which can be Encashed for that leave head for a single 
 entry 
 Max Encash 
 No refers 
 to how many times leave Encash can be processed for that leave head in 
 a single leave year period. 
 Path: 
 Setup Menu > Leave Setup > 
 Leave Master 
 Transaction Menu 
 Path: 
 Payroll > Advance > Leave Encashment 
 Leave Year: 
 Leave year is required to 
 be selected from drop down list 
 Employee: 
 Select the 
 required employee 
 Leave Head: 
 S elect 
 leave head from drop down list 
 Leave 
 Balance: R emaining Leave balance for the selected 
 leave head will be shown 
 Payment 
 Method: User c an select as per requirement. If Method selected 
 as Payslip it will be reflected in Payslip or If Method Selected as Voucher/Outside 
 Payslip it will be reflected in PRQ 
 Calculation 
 Basis: User can select as per requirement. 
 If Calculation Basis selected as Monthly 
 it will be calculated like 
 (Monthly CTC Amount of the formula given head / Days 
 in Month) * Encashed Days 
 If Calculation Basis selected 
 as Annually it will be calculated like 
 [(Monthly 
 CTC Amount of the formula given head * 12)/365] * Encashed Days 
 Payment Month: 
 User can 
 select as per requirement. 
 Note: Payslip 
 Generation should not be exists If payment Method chooses as Payslip. 
 Outside Payslip or Voucher not dependent to Payslip Generation. 
 Payment Date : 
 User can 
 select any date within the selected month 
 Encashed 
 Days : Number of days to be Encashed 
 for amount 
 Days In Month : 
 Selected 
 month’s days will be reflected automatically 
 Calculation 
 Factor : User c an select 
 from drop down list 
 Round Type : 
 User can 
 select from drop down for exact amount 
 Calculated 
 Amount : After selecting round 
 type calculated amount will be reflected automatically 
 Tax Amount : 
 Tax amount c an 
 be deducted as per requirements. 
 Net Amount : 
 Will be 
 displayed ( Calculated 
 Amount - Tax Amount ) 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 Variable

 There 
 are some components in the salary of an employee which are variables and

title: Payslip Generation
text:
Payslip Generation 
 Help > Transaction > Payout" />
 Tutorial: 
 Payslip Generation 
 Payslip 
 Generation 
 This interface calculates the various earnings 
 and deductions amounts based on the calculation method specified by the 
 user in the Pay Structure Definition 
 and other Statutory 
 Setup deduction modules such as Provident Fund, E.S.I, and Professional 
 Tax etc. The actual values in terms of rate, percentage, or amount are 
 picked up from the payroll settings in the Employee 
 Master . The generation process also takes into consideration the attendance 
 and related information from Monthly 
 Attendance . 
 Month Name : Select 
 the month for which payslip is to be generated 
 Company : Select the company name 
 where the employee is working 
 Business Unit : Business unit can 
 be selected 
 Office : Office name can be selected 
 Pay Structure : Pay Structure can 
 be selected (Defined through Payroll 
 > Setup > Earning Setup > Pay Structure Master ) 
 Employee : Select the name of the 
 employee whose payslip is to be generated (Defined through Payroll > Transaction > Employee 
 > Employee Master ) 
 Generate Salary : Click on the 
 “Generate Salary” button to generate payslip. 
 Tutorial: Payslip Generation 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

Final Settlement 
 Help > Transaction > Payout" />
 Final Settlement 
 The procedure of paying and recovering during the 
 resignation process is called the Final Settlement of the employee. Final 
 settlement entry for the resigned employee can be done here. 
 Month 
 Period : 
 Select the Month 
 Period 
 Employee : Select 
 the Employee 
 Notice 
 Period : 
 Put Notice 
 Period (if Any) 
 Based on Notice 
 Period Policy, values of Notice period will come automatically.

 when any amount to be recovered from the employee else select ' Payment' . 
 System will calculate 
 and display Gross Salary, Deduct Salary and

 Click on 'Generate_Final_Settlement' button. Click on 'Refresh', data

 Absent 
 days can be entered in the Grid.

title: Outside Payslip
text:
Outside Payslip 
 Help > Transaction > Payout" />
 Outside 
 Payslip 
 Through Outside 
 Payslip HR can give any amount to certain employees which will not show 
 in their Payslip. Employer can directly deduct tax on this amount. Employer 
 can make an entry from the frontend or can it be imported. The records 
 are non-editable. Record can be deleted. 
 Creation of Outside Payslip Earning Master 
 Path: 
 Payroll > Setup Menu > Earnings Setup > Earnings 
 Master 
 Identification 
 should be “OTHER” & Method Should be “Outside Payslip” 
 Identification 
 Method 
 Transaction of Outside Payslip 
 Payroll > Payout > Outside Payslip 
 In the Outside Payslip screen the mandatory fields 
 “Financial Year” , “Company” , “Month Period” , “Pay Setup”, “Employee” 
 , “Head Type”, “Head Code” are to be filled sequentially and the non-mandatory 
 fields “Business Unit” , “Office” and “Copy From Previous Month” 
 can be filled as per requirements. 
 Press the Refresh button to fetch the corresponding 
 data. 
 After that, fill in the required amount in the “Amount” 
 box for giving payment. Employer can also deduct Tax from entry in “TDS 
 Amount” field. Required notes can be written in “Remarks” field. 
 Outside Payslip Import 
 In Outside Payslip page go to Advance search, click 
 on Outside Payslip present in that Page and then Import. 
 Step1 : Download 
 the template for Outside Payslip. 
 Step2 : Fill 
 required Data in that Excel sheet 
 Step3 : Upload 
 the file and Start validation 
 Step4 : Proceed 
 for “Start import” if validation is successful. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Employee Full and Final Settlement
text:
Employee Full and Final Settlement 
 Help > Transaction > Payout" />
 Employee 
 Full and Final Settlement 
 Full 
 and Final Settlement process is done when an employee is 
 leaving the organization. At this time, he/she has to get paid for the 
 last working month + any additional earnings or deductions. The procedure 
 has to be carried out by the employer after the employee resigns from 
 their services. 
 The procedure of paying and recovering 
 during the resignation process is called the Final Settlement of the employee. 
 Process of Full and Final settlement 
 is as follows: 
 1. Marking an employee’s status as non WORKING 
 (e.g. RESIGNED) through Organisation Master 
 i) Select 
 Filter as Existing 
 Employee. 
 ii) Select 
 the Employee. System will show his/her current status 
 iii) Select 
 the Period from which he/she is non-WORKING 
 iv) System 
 will select the date from which the person will be non 
 working 
 v) Change 
 the current status by selecting RESIGNED from the drop down list 
 vi) Save 
 the Current status 
 2. Full and Final settlement entry 
 Path: Payroll > 
 Payout > 
 Final Settlement 
 i) Select 
 the Month Period 
 ii) Select 
 the Employee 
 iii) Put 
 Notice Period (if Any ) 
 iv) Select 
 Payment Type as Recovery 
 when any amount to be recovered from the employee else select Payment . 
 v) Based 
 on Notice Period Policy, values of Notice period will come automatic. 
 vi) Absent 
 days can be given in the Grid 
 vii) Now 
 Click on Generate_Final_Settlement 
 button 
 System will calculate 
 Gross Salary, Deduct Salary and Net Salary

 Leave Encashment Tab - if there is leave encashment policy in the Organization, 
 then based on the formula given in Pay Structure definition, leave 
 encashment value will automatically come on the particular leave balance 
 ix) In Salary 
 Details tab - in above screen there is an edit button, if any variable 
 values to be provided or edition to be done on any values 
 x) 
 Click on Submit button to save the Full and Final Settlement entry.

 and Final settlement Posting

 and Final Settlement Journal Posting

 Salary wise drop down, select 
 Final Settlement

 on Generate Journal button

title: Employee Expense
text:
Employee Expense 
 Help > Transaction > Payout" />
 Employee 
 Expense 
 Employee 
 Expense entry in payroll refers to the process of recording and managing 
 employee expenses, such as travel or office supplies, to ensure accurate 
 reimbursement and financial tracking. 
 Setup needs to be done for Employee Expense Entry 
 Earning 
 Head Setup 
 Path: Payroll >> Setup >> 
 Earning Setup >> Earning Master 
 For the Expense Entry, set 'Identification' 
 always 'Other' , choose 'Method' as 'Outside Payslip' , 
 and ensure 'Reimbursement' checkbox is checked . 
 Note: 
 No need 
 to add the expense head in the PayStructure Definition; it will automatically 
 be visible in the Expense Entry Transaction Screen. 
 Posting 
 Head Setup 
 Path: Payroll >> Setup >> 
 Posting Setup >> Posting Head Tag 
 The 
 Earning Head should be tagged in the Posting Head. 
 Steps to create Employee Expense Entry 
 Path: 
 Payroll >> Payout >> Employee Expense 
 Field 
 to be filled in Employee Expense 
 Entry Transaction Screen: 
 Employee: 
 Select 
 the employee for which the expense entry transaction is created. 
 Expense Month Name: This 
 field specifies the month for which the expenses are being reported. 
 Application Date : This 
 field indicates the date on which the expense application is submitted. 
 PRQ Document Date: This 
 is a non-editable field fetched from the Payment Requisition in the 
 finance module. A Payment Requisition will only be created if the 
 PRQ setup is enabled. 
 After 
 clicking 'Add New Row' , the 
 expense screen will pop up 
 with the fields mentioned below: 
 Date: This 
 field captures the date of the expense. 
 Expense: Only the Expense Specify earning 
 heads will be visible in the dropdown menu for selection. 
 City: This 
 field specifies the city where the expense was incurred. 
 Amount: This 
 field records the total amount of the expense. 
 Saved 
 entry will be visible in the Advance 
 search. 
 There 
 are two types of expense entry features available: one with 
 PRQ and another without PRQ. 
 Without PRQ: 
 Since 
 PRQ is disabled, the PRQ document data will not be fetched, and no payment 
 requisition will be created in Finance Module. 
 Path: Payroll >> Setup >> 
 Configuration >> Payment Requisition Setup 
 Path: 
 Payroll >> Payout >> Employee Expense 
 With 
 PRQ: 
 With 
 Single Head

title: Attendance Log
text:
Attendance Log 
 Help > Transaction > Biometric" />
 Attendance 
 Log 
 Attendance logging in biometric systems 
 is a digital record that tracks the presence of individuals using their 
 unique physical traits, such as fingerprints or facial recognition. The 
 log maintains a record of these punches, allowing organizations to effortlessly 
 track attendance, analyze patterns, and generate reports for various purposes, 
 such as payroll, compliance, and performance evaluation. 
 Introducing a new 
 addition to our Biometric Menu: Attendance 
 Log . This page will showcase a comprehensive record of punches made 
 by the selected employee throughout the day. Punches can be entered through 
 various methods – vendor machine, mobile app fingerprint, mobile app facial 
 recognition, outdoor punch, special concession and missed punch. 
 Setup 
 1. Employee 
 Master Menu: enter employee’s Biometric no in the Personal Information 
 screen and tick the Biometric Editable in Other Details Screen. 
 Biometric 
 – Attendance Log 
 Access attendance 
 data for a specific period by selecting both the "From Date" 
 and "To Date". This allows you to retrieve information for the 
 specified timeframe. 
 · Select 
 the employee for whom you would like to view the biometric attendance 
 data. 
 · Following 
 that, click on the "Refresh" option to retrieve the complete 
 attendance details for the specified employee and the indicated date range. 
 o The 
 initial three columns will display the employee's name, code, and punch 
 card number. 
 o In 
 the fourth and fifth column, the Punch Date and Punch Time will be displayed. 
 The In Time and Out Time entries will appear as separate rows, both showing 
 the same date. 
 o The 
 punch type might be labeled as "Mobile Punch," indicating that 
 it was generated using the mobile application. 
 o When 
 GPS data is accessible, such as through a mobile punch, the latitude and 
 longitude of the punch will be conveniently displayed. 
 o With 
 Face Attendance enabled, the system captures the employee's face during 
 each punch, ensuring accurate attendance records. 
 [Note: To do 
 attendance using Facial Recognition on the FvPay app, please ensure the 
 'Is Face Attendance Mandatory' checkbox is selected. Once enabled, the 
 system will automatically capture an employee's face when they use facial 
 recognition to punch in their attendance.] 
 Navigate 
 to the far right of each row and locate the 'Eye' icon. Click on this 
 icon to reveal the captured employee's face during attendance punching. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Processed Attendance
text:
Processed Attendance 
 Help > Transaction > Biometric" />
 Processed 
 Attendance 
 Using this menu, 
 you can monitor employee punch-in and punch-out statuses in real-time 
 and correct any discrepancies in the processed attendance records to ensure 
 accuracy. 
 Step 
 by Step process: 
 Path > Payroll > Biometric > 
 Processed Attendance 
 On 
 the processed attendance screen, fill in the “From 
 Date” and “To Date” fields 
 to display the desired interval, and use the “Employee” 
 field to view attendance for a specific employee. 
 After 
 entering the “From Date,” “To Date,” and “Employee” details, click the 
 “Refresh” button to display 
 all the relevant records. 
 We 
 will rectify the attendance of the employee “Tamal” 
 for 24 th January . 
 We can rectify 
 the Attendance Status, In Time 
 & out Time of the employee. 
 For 
 employee Tamal , the attendance for January 
 24, 2024 , has been rectified ( In 
 Time & Out Time ). This is indicated by the status ‘R’ . 
 Note: Once the monthly attendance is saved, 
 it is no longer possible to rectify the processed attendance. 
 There is a 
 report Called Processed Attendance 
 register that displays all the Processed 
 attendance Transactions. 
 Path: Payroll > Report > Attendance 
 Related > Processed Attendance Register 
 Backdated 
 Entry Restriction while 
 doing Rectification 
 This enhancement 
 ensures that the backdated restriction control now functions as intended, 
 allowing administrators to prevent users from entering backdated data 
 from the current date onward, thereby improving date validation on the 
 Processed Attendance page. 
 Path: 
 Administration >> Security >> User Date Restriction 
 Path: 
 Payroll >> Biometric >> Processed Attendance 
 In 
 this scenario, we will extract the attendance record for the employee 
 ‘Tamal’ for 14/5/2025(Absent), which comes under backdated entry 
 30 days from today (11/6/2025). 
 Since the entry is within the 30-day 
 backdate limit, it will be updated successfully. 
 In 
 this scenario, we will extract the attendance record for the employee 
 ‘Tamal’ for 11/5/2025, which 
 is a backdated entry exceeding 
 30 days from today (11/6/2025). 
 Since the entry exceeds the 30-day backdate 
 limit, a validation message will be displayed. 
 Note: - Please 
 note that the "Fin Year Restrictions" field 
 is currently not implemented. The functionality depends solely on the "Upto 
 Day(s)" field for now. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Employee CTC Register
text:
Employee CTC Register

 Employee 
 CTC Register 
 The Employee 
 CTC Register is a detailed record of all components of an employee's total 
 compensation, such as salary, allowances, bonuses, perquisites, gratuity, 
 provident fund contributions, medical insurance, and other benefits. 
 Path: Payroll >> Report 
 >> Employee >> Employee CTC Register 
 Click on the 
 Report option and go to Employee CTC Register. 
 Select 
 the financial year for which you want to export the CTC of an employee. 
 e.g. January-2024 
 The CTC 
 can be filtered by Enterprise, Company and Business Unit wise criteria. 
 E.g. 
 Select Location 
 Type: Company and then choose Company : GAMUT 
 INFOSYSTEMS LTD 
 You can select the Employee 
 Type as either “Blank ”, “Working" and 
 "Resign" . The data will be displayed accordingly. 
 · Blank: If the Employee 
 Type is left blank , 
 the Tag 
 CTC Employee field will display both working and resigned 
 employees. Additionally, when the report is exported, the CTC data for 
 both working and resigned employees will be visible. 
 · Working: 
 If the Employee Type is working , the Tag CTC employee 
 field will display only working employees and when the report is exported 
 only working employee’s data will be visible. 
 · Resign : 
 If the Employee Type is Resign , the Tag CTC employee 
 field will display only resigned employees and when the report is exported 
 only resigned employee’s data will be visible. 
 E.g. we are selecting Working as the Employee 
 Type. 
 You 
 can select the Report 
 View Type as either “As on Month" OR "Running" 
 OR “ Created on Month” 
 · Blank: 
 You cannot export the report 
 without filling in the Report View Type field. If this 
 field is left blank, an alert message will be displayed. 
 · As 
 on Month: Employee 
 Latest CTC will be visible up to the selected fiscal 
 period . 
 · Running: 
 It 
 means all the CTC data up to the selected month in the Fiscal period will 
 be displayed. 
 · Created 
 on Month: Employee CTC 
 will be visible if it was created in the 
 selected fiscal period. 
 E.g. 
 we are selecting Created on Month in the Report View Type. 
 In the CTC Employee 
 Register, you can export the CTC data for "All" employees 
 or a "Tag" employee. By clicking on the Tag option, 
 you will see a list of employees based on the selected Location Type, 
 Employee Type and Report View Type . The displayed list will 
 vary according to these selections . 
 E.g 1) If 
 you select Location 
 Type as 'Company: 
 GAMUT INFOSYSTEMS LTD', Employee 
 Type as 'Working', 
 Report View Type 
 as 'As on Month' and 
 the Fiscal Period as “January-2024”, the corresponding employees 
 will be displayed.

title: Employee Pay Register New
text:
Employee Pay Register New 
 Reports > Employee Payout" />
 Employee Pay Register New Report with 
 CTC format 
 A 
 new ‘With CTC Value’ checkbox has been added to the Employee 
 Pay Register New Report . When enabled, the MRT print will display 
 the CTC amount of earnings and deduction heads (selected in the designer) . 
 If disabled, the CTC amount will be stamped as 0 . 
 · Steps 
 to design MRT for Employee Pay Register 
 Path: Administration >> Designer >> Document 
 Designer 
 To 
 design the MRT for the Employee Pay Register, go to the Document Designer 
 menu, select 'Payroll' as 
 the Application , and choose 
 'PAY REGISTER' as the Entry 
 Type. 
 Copy 
 the system format to design 
 a customized Pay Register MRT layout. 
 Define 
 the name of the Format and click on submit to create MRT. 
 The 
 'Edit' button should be clicked 
 on the format that was created to design the MRT. 
 A 
 new schema, SalaryHeadDetailsCTCInformation , has been added to 
 capture all earning and deduction components of CTC. 
 o CEH represents 
 Earning Heads 
 o CDH represents 
 Deduction Heads 
 Drag 
 and drop the required schemas into the layout to make the fields visible 
 in the print format. 
 If 
 the schemas are not visible or data does not appear after placing 
 them in the layout , navigate to the Admin Module, open the Sync 
 menu, and initiate the sync process . In case you have been advised 
 to not do a mongo sync, please reach out to the Administration team to 
 help you with the same. 
 Path: 
 Administration >> API Integration >> Sync 
 Note: 
 The format customization will be handled by the MRT 
 team . Alternatively, users with the required knowledge can manually 
 create the format themselves

title: Missed Punch Report
text:
Missed Punch Report 
 Reports > Attendance Related" />
 Missed Punch 
 Report 
 The 
 Missed Punch Report in the Payroll Module provides HR and Payroll 
 users with a detailed view of attendance records where employees have 
 applied a Missed Punch entry after failing to punch in or out. The report 
 can be filtered by Location Type, Approval Status, Date Range, and 
 Employee selection . This feature supports tracking, verifying, and 
 managing missed punch applications for attendance corrections. 
 Step-by-Step 
 Process: 
 Path: Payroll 
 → 
 Report 
 → 
 Attendance 
 Related → 
 Missed 
 Punch Report . 
 Select 
 Location Type : 
 Choose 
 from Enterprise , Company , or Business 
 Unit . 
 Select 
 Approval Status : 
 All → 
 Displays 
 both pending and approved records. 
 Pending → 
 Displays 
 only pending records for the selected date range. 
 Approved → 
 Displays 
 only approved records for the selected date range. 
 Select 
 Date Range : 
 Enter From 
 Date and To Date . 
 Select 
 Employee Filter : 
 Tag → 
 Tag 
 one or more specific employees. 
 All → View 
 all employees based on the filters applied. 
 Click Refresh to 
 load the report. 
 View 
 Grid Columns : 
 Code, 
 Full Name, Company Name, Salary Business Unit, Application 
 Date, Document No, Miss Punch Date, In Time, Out Time, Applied 
 In Time, Applied Out Time, Approval Status, Remarks, Approvers. 
 Export 
 Data : 
 Click 
 the Excel icon to export the report. 
 BU-wise Tagging 
 Explanation : 
 For 
 Admin users , all records will be displayed, regardless of whether 
 a BU is tagged or not. 
 For Non-admin users , 
 BU access must first be configured by an Admin. To enable this: 
 · Navigate to Administration 
 → Security → User-BU 
 Tagging . 
 · Select the non-admin user 
 who requires BU access. 
 · Assign the relevant Business Unit(s) to that 
 user. 
 Once this setup is completed, 
 the Missed Punch Report will only display records for the Business Units 
 tagged to that non-admin user. If a user is assigned to a single BU, only 
 data from that BU will appear. If multiple BUs are tagged, data will be 
 visible for all those BUs. 
 · When a non-admin user logs 
 in , the Missed Punch Report will only display records for employees 
 belonging to the assigned BU(s) of their company. 
 · If the user is tagged to only 
 one company and BU , then only data for that specific company and BU 
 will appear on the screen. 
 · Filters (Approval Status, 
 Date Range, Tag/All Employees) will work within the scope of their 
 assigned BU(s) . 
 · This ensures controlled access and prevents 
 cross-company or cross-BU data exposure. 
 Example : 
 If HR selects:

title: Reimbursement Process
text:
Reimbursement Process 
 Tutorial" />
 Reimbursement 
 Process 
 Reimbursement 
 is compensation paid by an organization for out-of-pocket expenses incurred 
 or overpayment made by an employee - reimbursement of business expenses 
 are common examples. However, unlike typical compensation, reimbursement 
 is not subject to taxation. 
 1. Creation 
 of Earning Head: 
 Identification 
 = Reimbursement 
 Method = 
 Reimbursement 
 Reimbursement 
 Checkbox should be checked 
 CTC applicable = defines whether it 
 is a part of the employee’s CTC or not 
 Note: 
 i) If carry 
 forward Applicable then the previous unpaid amount will be carried 
 forward to next month. 
 ii) If Maximum limit value is greater 
 than 0, then the monthly reimbursement that is generated cannot be greater 
 than this limit. “0” means no restriction. 
 2 . Creation 
 of Paystructure Definition: 
 CTC 
 based Head: Reimbursement 
 amount is set in CTC entry and can be pro-rated or fixed. 
 Calculation Type = Prorata Basis / Other 
 Fixed amount / Present Days. 
 Variable 
 Mode: Amount is defined through 
 Reimbursement variable input. 
 Calculation Type = Amount to be asked. 
 3 . Reimbursement 
 Transaction: 
 Monthly 
 Reimbursement Generation: 
 Amount 
 given in CTC based Head: 
 Amount 
 will automatically populate while doing Monthly Reimbursement 
 Amount 
 Given by Variable Input: 
 For 
 details go to Reimbursement 
 > Reimbursement Variable Entry 
 4 . Generating 
 Monthly Reimbursement: 
 Note: 
 i) For Generating Monthly Reimbursement, 
 Monthly attendance need to be present on that month for those employee/employees’. 
 ii) 
 If 
 Maximum Limit logic applicable in Earning Master then the amount will 
 be generated accordingly. 
 For 
 details go to Reimbursement > Monthly 
 Reimbursement

 if someone wants to adjust employees’ payment this menu can be used. It 
 can only be generated before Payment. After adjustment, amount will reflect 
 in Reimbursement payment screen. 
 For 
 details go to 
 Reimbursement > Reimbursement 
 Adjustment 
 6 . Reimbursement 
 Payment flow: 
 After generating reimbursement payment, 
 amount will be credited to employees bank account after journal and posting 
 have been done. Employer can choose the payment bank - whether they want 
 to give him reimbursement in his Salary Bank or Reimbursement Bank. 
 If someone wants to give Reimbursement 
 to employee’s Reimbursement bank then it requires to setup 
 A. 
 Reimbursement Bank Master 
 B. Employee Reimbursement Bank

 “Prefer 
 Reimbursement bank” checkbox should be checked in Preference Setup.

 wants to give reimbursement in his salary bank 
 then he can simply ignore that step.

 details go to Payroll 
 > Setup > Reimbursement > Reimbursement 
 Bank Master 
 B. 
 Employee Reimbursement Bank setup 
 For details 
 go to Payroll > Reimbursement 
 > Employee Reimbursement Bank 
 Note: 
 Month cannot be selected 
 in which a payment has been done previously. 
 C. 
 Generate reimbursement Payment 
 For 
 details go to Payroll 
 > Reimbursement > Reimbursement payment

 After payment, report can be checked 
 from Report Menu.

 Payroll 
 > Report menu > Reimbursement

 report:

 Flow for Employee Portal 
 This 
 document provides a step-by-step guide on how to submit and manage reimbursement 
 requests through the employee portal. 
 Reimbursement Transaction:- 
 Monthly Reimbursement Generation:- 
 o Amount given in CTC based Head 
 Amount will 
 be automatically populate while doing Monthly Reimbursement 
 o Amount Given by Variable Input:

 > Submit

 someone doesn’t use the Reimbursement payment by variable 
 entry, then this menu can be skipped

 amounts will be displayed.

text:
Process Methodology for Financial Budget control for Salary 
 Tutorial" />
 Process 
 Methodology for Financial Budget Control for Salary 
 1. Generate a “Budget Group” 
 within the Engineering Module 
 Establish 
 corresponding Account Heads in the Financial Module for the Earning 
 and Deduction components of the Payroll Module. Additionally, if Reimbursement 
 Expenses are to be routed through the Payroll Module and budget tracking 
 is required, Account heads must be created for the Reimbursement Heads 
 as well. 
 3. 3. Create 
 a “Budget Head” under the said Group in the Engineering module. 
 3. 4. 
 Use the 'Mapping Head' option to link the created Accounts Heads to the 
 Budget Head. Tag all the Earning and Deduction heads that are linked to 
 Account heads for Budget tracking purposes.

 Ensure all the Account Heads mapped in Budget Heads are tagged in the 
 Payroll module-Posting Set Up- Posting Head Tag. This needs to be done 
 for all Earning, Deduction, Reimbursement Heads, and Employer Contribution 
 Heads. 
 3. 6. 
 After completing these steps, please notify the Kolkata Payroll Module 
 Support Desk to perform the back-end configuration of the Budget Head 
 with Account Heads, and obtain confirmation of the configuration completion. 
 3. 7. 
 Users need to enter the Budgeted Amount from Engineering Module-Project 
 Budget. 
 3. 
 8. 8. If the Salary 
 Budget must be monitored on a monthly basis, it should be configured using 
 the Engineering Module-Project Budget on a monthly basis. The budget amount 
 for each month should be entered. Prior to configuring the Project Budget 
 on a monthly basis, please notify the Kolkata Engineering Support Desk. 
 9.

 Module.

text:

 Tutorial" />
 Leave Encashment 
 "Leave 
 encashment" refers to the compensation or payment made in return 
 for unused leaves. HR can issue encashments for an employee. This can 
 be done during the employment, or while retiring, as per the organization's 
 policy. 
 Any 
 leave encashment is taxable as it is considered as income from salary. 
 In this case, the employee can get tax relief under Section 89. As per 
 Section 89, the employee can claim tax relief from the amount received 
 through the leave encashment process. 
 Step by Step Process 
 Setup Menu

 of Earning Head:

 Checkbox should not be checked

 applicable = defines whether it is a part of the employee’s CTC or not

 of Paystructure Definition:

 will be varies depending on the Formula

 Creation:

 checkbox 
 should be checked for Leave Encash process

 refers 
 to the Leave head under which leave encashment is applicable

 to the minimum days required in that leave head for leave encashment for 
 a single entry 
 Maximum Days

 to the maximum days which can be Encashed for that leave head for a single 
 entry 
 Max Encash 
 No refers 
 to how many times leave Encash can be processed for that leave head in

 Employee 
 Welcome Mail 
 Triggering Employee Welcome Mail 
 In this new feature, we have added functionality 
 that allows employers to automatically send an email when a new employee 
 is created via the Employee Master or when a candidate joins 
 through the ELC module . The email will be sent to the address provided 
 in the Employee Master or Candidate Master. 
 A.Steps to create Employee Welcome Letter 
 Template 
 Path: 
 Administration 
 Module > Communicator > Template - Email 
 Step 
 1: Select "Employee Master" 
 as the entry type to create the Employee Welcome Letter template. 
 Note: 
 If 
 "Employee Master" is not visible in the Entry Type dropdown 
 on the Template - Email Main Info page, go to the sync 
 option in the Administration module and sync 
 the system. 
 Step 2: When 
 creating the “Employee Welcome Master” template, ensure that in ‘To’ field 
 {{ToEmail}} is filled, it cannot be left blank else the mail will not 
 get triggered. 
 Step 
 3: In 
 the “ Subject” and “Body” fields, select the template as needed. 
 All Employee Master Fields will be visible in the dropdown menu. 
 o Subject 
 o Body 
 Step 
 4: Click on “Submit” button 
 to create a new template. 
 Note: 
 To 
 send the Welcome 
 Mail, ensure that the "Communication Rule" is created. 
 Step 
 6: To 
 send the welcome mail via Payroll -, set the Operation as 
 “Save” to create the Communication Rule. 
 Step 
 7: To send the welcome mail 
 via Employee Life Cycle, set the Operation as “Edit”, 
 to create the Communication Rule. 
 Steps 
 to send Welcome Letter to Employee via Payroll 
 Path: 
 Payroll 
 > Employee > Create a new Employee Master 
 Step 
 1: Create 
 the employee from the employee master. 
 Note: 
 The 
 “Welcome Email” will be triggered when a New Employee master is created. 
 Step 
 2: When creating the Employee Master, 
 the email address must be entered on the Contact Information page otherwise; 
 the welcome email will not be triggered. 
 Step 
 3: Once the 
 employee master is saved, the email will be automatically triggered. 
 Steps to send Welcome Letter to Employee 
 via ELC 
 Path: 
 Employee 
 Life Cycle > Employee > Employee Master 
 Step 
 1: Create 
 the employee from the Candidate 
 Master menu in Employee Life Cycle. 
 Step 2: When 
 creating the Candidate Master, ensure that the email address is entered 
 on the Contact Detail page; otherwise, the welcome email will not be triggered. 
 Step 3: After creating the 
 employee from the Candidate Master, the email will be triggered once the 
 candidate has joined.

title: Alert Configuration setup for ‘Employee Confirmation
text:
Alert Configuration setup for ‘Employee Confirmation 
 Tutorial" />
 Alert Configuration 
 setup for ‘Employee Confirmation' 
 Email notifications will now be triggered 
 to the Reporting Manager prior to an employee’s confirmation date, ensuring 
 that no confirmation actions are overlooked. 
 Path: 
 Payroll >> Setup >> configuration >> Alert Configuration 
 ‘Employee 
 Confirmation’ Alert Configuration Explanation: 
 In this 
 setup, you can configure when email alerts should be triggered for Employee Confirmation events. 
 The alert timing is controlled using two fields: Days and Time . 
 Type: should be Employee 
 Confirmation 
 Days : 
 Specifies how many days before confirmation the system should check 
 for Employee Confirmation. 
 Time : 
 Specifies the exact time of day when the alert email should be sent. 
 Example 
 – 1 Days Configuration: 
 If the Days 
 field is set to 1 and the Time is set to 11:00 AM , 
 the system will identify employees whose confirmation is scheduled for 
 tomorrow (i.e., August 12, 2025 ) and will send an email 
 alert to their reporting manager today ( August 11, 2025 ) 
 at 11:00 AM . 
 Example 
 – 3 Days Configuration: 
 If 
 the Days field is set to 3 and the Time is set to 
 11:00 AM , the system will identify employees whose confirmation 
 is scheduled for three days from now (i.e., August 14, 2025 ) 
 and will send an email alert to their reporting manager today 
 ( August 11, 2025 ) at 11:00 AM . 
 Path: 
 Administration >> Communicator >> Template - Email 
 Email 
 template to be configured for the Confirmation 
 Letter 
 The recipient's 
 email address should be entered in the 'To' field to ensure the 
 alert is delivered directly to them.

 In the Body

title: Sandwich Policy Setup
text:
Sandwich Policy Setup 
 Tutorial" />
 Sandwich 
 Policy Setup 
 In 
 this enhancement, if an employee applies for Leave/Absent 
 both before and after an 
 off day/holiday , the off 
 day/holiday will be treated as Sandwich 
 leave/Sandwich Absent, if sandwich policy defined in shift master 
 then the deduction will happened on the basis of the formula given in 
 the Shift Master . 
 Setup 
 to create Sandwich Policy: 
 Path: Payroll >> Setup >> Attendance 
 >> Shift Master 
 Open 
 Setup and click on Shift 
 Master . 
 There are three types of Sandwich Policy Setup: 
 · Sandwich 
 Absent: If any off day/ holiday comes between an employee's absences, 
 the status will be marked as Sandwich (Sw). 
 Example: If an employee is absent from 30/11/202 4 
 to 02/12/2024 , and 01/12/2024 is an off Day and in 
 Formula deduction basis is absent then the status will be marked 
 as "SW AB" since the employee was absent both before 
 and after the holiday. 
 Deduction basis is absent: 
 · Sandwich Leave: If an employee applies for leave 
 both before and after an off day/holiday, the off day/holiday will be 
 treated as Sandwich (Sw). 
 Example: 
 If an employee is on Leave from 08/11/2024 to 11/08/2024 , 
 and 09/11/2024 & 10/11/2024 is an 
 off Day and in Formula deduction basis is Leave then 
 the status will be marked as "SW LV" since the employee 
 was on Leave both before and after the holiday 
 Deduction 
 basis is Leave: 
 · Sandwich 
 Leave & Absent: If an employee applies for leave before an off 
 day/holiday and get absent after an off day/holiday then the status will 
 be treated as Sandwich Leave & Absent. 
 Example: 
 If an employee is absent on 16/11/2024, Leave on 18/11/2024 
 and 17/11/2024 is an off Day and in Formula deduction basis 
 is Absent then the status will be marked as "SW AB" since 
 the employee was on Leave before the holiday and Absent after the holiday. 
 Deduction basis is absent: 
 If 
 the absent count is showing a mismatch, tick the 
 "Exclude Offday Holiday in LMS" checkbox in the Preference 
 Setup. 
 Note: 
 1) If an employee's status falls under the sandwich policy, it will affect 
 their monthly attendance record. 
 2) This feature will be applicable for both Biometric 
 and Non-biometric user. 
 3) 
 In the Preference Setup, a new checkbox field 'Apply Sandwich Leave/Absent 
 For Full Day Only' has been added. This field allows us to control the 
 sandwich policy, ensuring it applies only to full-day absent/Leave and 
 not to half-day absent/Leave when enabled. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 Setup > Day Type Master ) 
 If Half Day is chosen then Period Type 
 needs to be selected as shown below.

 From Date 
 and To 
 Date that is the start date 
 and end date of leave applied

 Leave : Total leave days will 
 be shown as count in the leave application screen

 (Not Mandatory)

 (Not Mandatory)

 Reporting Manager or ‘Reports To’ can apply for Leave on behalf of his/her 
 sub-ordinate employee from Employee Portal. After applying, it will go

 Now, after activating this 
 preference, when Reporting Manager or ‘Reports To’ needs to login into 
 the Employee Portal and open the Leave Entry Screen, in the Employee Control, 
 by default login employee name will be displayed. 
 Then user needs to click on 
 the Binocular Button of Employee Control and it will open a popup window 
 containing all employee names under that employee. User can select an 
 employee and complete the leave entry process.
