title: FAQ
text:
Frequently Asked Questions 
 Frequently 
 Asked Questions 
 Q: How can 
 I adjust advance? 
 Answer: There are two ways to adjust an Advance 
 Entry. 
 a. Amount of an installment 
 can be changed via installment adjustment. 
 b. Total taken advance 
 amount can be changed via Amount adjustment. 
 Q: Where 
 can I see the reflection of the advance I/employee have received? 
 Answer: 
 Advance taken can be seen in PRQ Generation in Finance. In Payroll, 
 the deduction will reflect as and when it is deducted against monthly 
 salary. 
 Q: How to calculate 
 Gratuity in FNF? 
 Answer: Gratuity is calculated automatically 
 in Payroll based on the following conditions. 
 a. Earning 
 Head should be created with Identification “GRATUITY”. 
 b. In Paystructure definition of GRATUITY, only BASIC 
 needs to be added in the Formula section. 
 c. Employee 
 should have completed 4 years 
 and 240 days of work at the time of FNF generation. 
 Q: While Generating 
 FNF is it necessary to complete normal attendance and Payslip upto resign 
 month? 
 Answer: It is not necessary to generate attendance 
 & Payslip upto present month for generating FNF. Employer can 
 stop generating attendance & Payslip from before. The attendance 
 and Payslip amount will be reflected in FNF Transaction Screen. 
 Note: Attendance and Payslip both need to 
 be stopped. 
 Q: “Approval 
 information does not exist” error coming in employee portal. 
 Answer: If 
 any entry type does not contain any Business Rule or the rule not 
 satisfied for that employee then it will give error like “Approval 
 information does not exist” and the entry will not be saved. 
 Q : How can I enable Aadhar Card No . field in 
 employee master ? 
 Answer: Open 
 Admin Module > Database > Metadata > Select Payroll > 
 Click on Entity name (EmployeeDetails.EmployeeExtraInfo) > Edit 
 > Switch properties tab > Click on AadharNo. > Make Is Required 
 True > Save > Submit. 
 Q : How can I deduct ESIC when salary is 
 more than 21000 per month? 
 Answer: Open setup menu > Localisation > 
 Statutory Master > Select Proper ESI entry > edit the ESI entry 
 > click on “ i” button 
 present in the exact right position of the Template > remove tick 
 mark from statutory. 
 Q : PTAX not deducted. How can I fix this? 
 Answer: There 
 are several possibilities for this. Check all the required points 
 mentioned below: 
 a. 
 In Statutory Master, PTAX should be created for that Company and in 
 the template grid all the required states should be present. 
 b. In CTC, PTAX head should be applicable. 
 c. In deduction Master, PTAX head’s Identification 
 should be Professional Tax. 
 d. In Paystructure definition, calculation 
 type should be on Prorata basis and the calculation will depend upon 
 formula. 
 e. In employee master Is 
 Handicapped should be false. 
 f. State name should be properly filled 
 in Ptax Applicable entity 
 of localization tab which is located in Office master menu. 
 Q : Why am I getting error “Future Year 
 Leave Balance Data Exists: Duplicate Record” while deleting monthly Attendance? 
 Answer: If future year’s leave opening data already 
 exists for that employee then the attendance data cannot be deleted. 
 If you want to delete attendance, first you must delete the leave 
 opening and entry in the future leave year. 
 Q : Leave Head not appearing in Compensatory 
 Leave for adjust. How can I solve? 
 Answer: Leave 
 Head will appear in compensatory leave entry if 
 a. 
 Leave Type set as Compensatory 
 Leave in Leave Master for that Leave Head. 
 b. 
 Leave head has >= 0 
 value in leave opening. 
 Q : How can I enable Sandwich Leave ? 
 Answer: Open 
 Setup menu > Leave Master > Open any leave setup via advance 
 search > Edit > Switch to Extra Info tab > Exclude 
 Holiday Off day checkbox needs to be checked. 
 Q : If an employee takes a leave before 
 or after a holiday/offday I want the holiday to be counted as a leave. 
 How can I do this? 
 Answer: Open 
 Setup menu > Leave Master > Open any leave setup via advance 
 search > Edit > Switch to Extra Info tab > Exclude 
 Holiday Off day checkbox needs to be checked. 
 Q : I am not able to see Manual Attendance 
 menu from mobile app. How can I fix this issue? 
 Answer: Below 
 steps are necessary to see the menu 
 a. In employee Master should have 
 unique Biometric No. 
 for that employee. 
 b . Biometric Editable checkbox should be checked in Other 
 Details page of Employee Master. 
 c. Employee should have that menu 
 right for Manual Attendance (Given through User Rights menu). 
 Q : How can I see my Payslip on my mobile 
 app or Employee Portal? 
 Answer: Payroll > Setup Menu > Configuration 
 > Payslip Show (Employee 
 Needs to be tagged). 
 Q : I want to enable PRQ (Payment Requisition) 
 for Employee Advance and Outside Payslip. How to do that? 
 Answer: Payroll > Setup Menu > Configuration 
 > Payment Requisition Setup > Edit and make true for required 
 menu (Employee advance /Outside Payslip) 
 Q : Leave Head is not appearing when trying 
 to generate Leave Carry Forward. How can I solve this? 
 Answer: Leave 
 Head will appear in Leave Carry Forward if 
 a. Carry Forward 
 Applicable should be true in Leave Master for that leave head. 
 b. Carry Forward Head should be 
 mentioned properly. 
 Q : Provisional 
 employee is Applying for leaves. How can I restrict it? 
 Answer: Availed For Confirmed Employees 
 checkbox should be true in Main 
 Info tab of Leave Master for that leave head. 
 Q : Employee 
 not displayed when trying to generate Salary payment. How can I solve 
 it ? 
 Answer: There are several possibilities 
 to occur such issues. Check below mentioned points 
 a. Salary 
 Journal might be provisional 
 or not generated yet. 
 b. Employee’s 
 salary may be on Hold. 
 c. 
 Employee’s Salary payment may already be done. 
 d. 
 Salary Wise field value 
 may not be accurate. 
 Q : I 
 just applied for a leave but it has not been reflected in Processed Attendance. 
 What is the Issue ? 
 Answer: Run Attendance Process needs to be generated for 
 that employee and for that month before checking Processed Attendance. 
 Q : Cannot 
 find Employee in Monthly Attendance. How Can I find employee in Sequence 
 via Employee Code or Employee Name ? 
 Answer: You can do this via Employee Search Order Criteria 
 option present in Preference setup. Value=1 for employee Name and 
 value=0 for Employee Code wise search. 
 Q : We have generated 
 more than 2000 records in Payslip generation. It’s taking a lot of time 
 to complete. How can I solve this issue ? 
 Answer: You can enable the Queue process for payslip generation. 
 Payroll > Setup menu > Configuration > Preference Setup > 
 Bulk Salary Process Limit > change it to any value which is greater 
 than 0. 
 Q : While 
 doing Salary Payment bank, ledger is not showing. How can I solve it ? 
 Answer: Account Head should be present in Bank Master for 
 the particular entry. 
 Q : Calculated 
 Amount showing 0 while I try to create leave encashment. How can I solve 
 it? 
 Answer: Below mentioned steps are necessary for doing a leave 
 encashment 
 a. Formula should 
 be properly written in Leave Encashment head of that Paystructure 
 Definition. 
 b. Calculation type should be defined 
 as Prorata Basis. 
 Q : Showing 
 error “Update Leave increment calculation basis of leave head” while trying 
 to save attendance. How can I solve this? 
 Answer: Leave Increment Setup needs to be updated in Leave 
 increment enabled head in Leave Master. 
 Path : Payroll > Setup > Leave Setup 
 > Leave Master > Select Incremental leave heads one by one > 
 Edit > switch to increment tab > Increment days and calculation 
 Basis should be properly mentioned. 
 Q : Showing 
 time range error while saving Outdoor entry. How can I fix this issue? 
 Answer: Entered time is not satisfying the Quarter day master’s 
 time. Please update the Quarter Day Master according to your needs. 
 Path: Payroll > Setup Menu > leave 
 Setup > Quarter Day Master 
 Q : One 
 earning head’s value is present in Payslip but not coming while generating 
 Salary Journal of all employees. How can I solve this? 
 Answer: Check Whether Posting Head is properly 
 tagged for that earning head. 
 Q : Can 
 I add KRA/KPI details into 
 Offer Letter or Appointment Letter? 
 Answer: Yes, KRA/KPI details can be added in Offer/Appointment 
 letter. You just need to add the field in MRT format. 
 P ath: Admin Module > Designer > Document 
 Designer > Choose Application & Entry Type > Add Scope 
 of Work in required format. 
 Q : After 
 editing savings declaration from employee portal, does it go for approval 
 again? 
 Answer: Yes, entry will go for approval each time 
 after edit if the Business Rule exists. 
 Q : If 
 I don’t want Biometric attendance for an employee. What should I do? 
 Answer: Biometric number needs to be removed from 
 employee master for that employee. 
 Q : Can 
 I change Leave encashment value while doing FNF? 
 Answer: If Leave Encashment head is tagged in CTC, 
 employer can process Leave Encashment. While doing FNF employer needs 
 to switch into Leave Encashment tab > Change the number of days 
 of leave encashment > switch to Main Info > Generate Payment. 
 Q : How 
 can I pay bonus to an employee through FNF? 
 Answer: In bonus generation you need to select 
 Payment 
 Type as FNF Payslip. 
 Q : How 
 can I give percentage-based increment? 
 Answer: Through Paystructure Wise CTC menu 
 employer can give Percentage-based increment. 
 Q : Unable 
 to approve Expense entry. Showing error “Not Found: Earning Head [ext]”. 
 What could be the issue? 
 Answer: The issue may be due to the Earning Head not being 
 created properly. Please ensure the following steps are followed correctly 
 in the Earning master: 
 a. 
 I dentification should be 
 set to “Other”. 
 b. Method should be defined as 
 Outside Payslip/Voucher. 
 c. 
 Ensure the Reimbursement checkbox is checked or marked True. 
 Q : Leave Balance is showing zero despite setting the increment for 
 that leave head. What could be the issue? 
 Answer: There may be some setup issues. Please 
 ensure the following steps are followed correctly: 
 a. 
 I t is necessary to save 
 monthly attendance for that month to get the leave increment. 
 b. Ensure that the 
 Leave Increment setup is saved in the Increment tab for that specific 
 leave head. 
 c. Increment Days value should 
 be greater than 0 in Increment setup. 
 d. 
 Verify that the Calculation basis via monthly attendance satisfies 
 the requirements of the Increment Days. 
 Q : ESI 
 is not deducted from the Salary. How can I resolve this issue? 
 Answer: This problem may stem from setup issues. 
 Please ensure the following steps are correctly implemented: 
 a. 
 In the Deduction master, 
 ensure that the identification is saved as "ESI CONTRIBUTION," 
 the Method is set as "Payslip," and the Effective From date 
 is set before the present day. 
 b. In Paystructure Definition Formula, 
 the formula for the ESI head should be correctly specified. 
 c. In the Statutory Master, ensure that 
 the ESI template is properly added for the respective Company. 
 d. Check the CTC with respect to ESI 
 formula and verify whether Salary amount crossed 21000 
 or not [when there is Statutory 
 Limit, check in Statutory master] 
 e. 
 Ensure that the ESI Applicable checkbox is true for that employee’s 
 Office master. 
 Q : Paystructure 
 wise posting is setup in Account Posting Category but while generating 
 Salary Journal, the data is not appearing. How can I solve this? 
 Answer: Please verify if the earnings and deductions 
 heads are correctly tagged with the selected Paystructure in the Posting Head Tag menu. 
 Q : I 
 have allocated a certain amount in CTC, but it is not reflecting in the 
 Payslip. What could be the issue? 
 Answer: If the Mode 
 is set as “Amount to be asked” in Paystructure Definition, the CTC 
 value will not be considered for that head. The payable amount must 
 be generated via variable input transaction screen. 
 Q : Certain 
 employee names are not appearing when creating Employee Special Concessions 
 via Payroll. What could be causing this? 
 Answer: Verify if the Reimbursement Payment entries 
 are Provisional or not. 
 Q : How 
 can I look up employee details using their PAN 
 No ? 
 Answer: In the Employee Master, choose PAN 
 No as the Advanced search criteria. This will display all PAN 
 numbers associated with employees. 
 N ote: Employee Name and Employee Code can 
 also be selected as Search criteria. 
 Q : Can 
 employees submit their resignations through Farvision? 
 Answer: Yes, employees can submit their resignations 
 through the Resignation Apply 
 entry under the Exit Process menu available in their employee portal. 
 Q : How 
 can I process Salary Prorata in a particular manner where Work Days can 
 be set manually for a month? 
 Answer: Simply enter the desired value in Work 
 Days field under Paystructure Definition menu for that specific 
 head. 
 Q : Rectification 
 option is not showing in processed attendance. How can I solve it? 
 Answer: PunchTime and Absent Data Rectification 
 option should be true in 
 Preference Setup. 
 Q : Unable 
 to see my Subordinate's attendance data. How can I solve it? 
 Answer: Apply LeaveOD 
 By ReportsTo option 
 should be true in Preference Setup. 
 Q : Can't 
 set Religion wise holiday. How can I solve it? 
 Answer: This problem may stem 
 from setup issues. Please ensure the following steps are correctly 
 implemented: 
 1. From setup menu Holiday Type Master 
 needs to be created while Category should be “Restricted” 
 and choose required Religion. 
 · 2. 
 In Holiday Master that created 
 Holiday Type master needs to be mapped with. 
 · 3. 
 After that Holiday Date needs 
 to be created financial year and office wise 
 Path:-Payroll 
 > Annual > Holiday date > Choose Financial year and Office 
 > add new row > Select Holiday Name > From Date & To 
 Date >Save > Submit. 
 Q : Employee 
 Payment is shown blank in Salary Details option present in Widget. What 
 is the issue? 
 Answer: Please verify if the Salary Payment of 
 that is already done or not for that Company/Business Unit. 
 Note: 
 · 1. 
 Value will show in NetSalary 
 if the Payslip Generation has been done for that month. 
 · 2. 
 Value will show in Liability 
 if the Salary Journal has been done for that month. 
 · 3. 
 Value will show in EmployeePayment 
 if the Salary Payment 
 already done for that month.

 Period wise Earning or Deduction not working while doing FNF. How can 
 I solve it? 
 Answer: This problem may stem from setup issues. 
 Please ensure the following steps are correctly implemented: 
 1. For Earnings 
 needs to create one head in earning master and the head’s Identification 
 should be set as “NOTICEPERIOD” 
 2.

 and the head’s Identification should be set as “NOTICEPERIOD”

 F 
 Formula is 
 mandatory in Paystructure Definition to calculate the amount in FNF.

 want to carry forward only 10 leave days while I have closing balance 
 30. How can I process such? 
 Answer: 
 “ Limit (In 
 Days)” needs to be set as 10 in Leave Master for that head.

 I Hold Salary after saving the Salary Journal ? 
 Answer: 
 Salary Hold is dependent on Salary 
 Payment. Employers can create a Salary Hold till Salary Payment is 
 not done.

 Employee’s present status in Organisation master is “RESIGNED”, can he/she

 Answer: The

Frequently Asked Questions 
 Frequently 
 Asked Questions 
 Q: How can 
 I adjust advance? 
 Answer: There are two ways to adjust an Advance 
 Entry. 
 a. Amount of an installment 
 can be changed via installment adjustment. 
 b. Total taken advance 
 amount can be changed via Amount adjustment. 
 Q: Where 
 can I see the reflection of the advance I/employee have received? 
 Answer: 
 Advance taken can be seen in PRQ Generation in Finance. In Payroll, 
 the deduction will reflect as and when it is deducted against monthly 
 salary. 
 Q: How to calculate 
 Gratuity in FNF? 
 Answer: Gratuity is calculated automatically 
 in Payroll based on the following conditions. 
 a. Earning 
 Head should be created with Identification “GRATUITY”. 
 b. In Paystructure definition of GRATUITY, only BASIC 
 needs to be added in the Formula section. 
 c. Employee 
 should have completed 4 years 
 and 240 days of work at the time of FNF generation. 
 Q: While Generating 
 FNF is it necessary to complete normal attendance and Payslip upto resign 
 month? 
 Answer: It is not necessary to generate attendance 
 & Payslip upto present month for generating FNF. Employer can 
 stop generating attendance & Payslip from before. The attendance 
 and Payslip amount will be reflected in FNF Transaction Screen. 
 Note: Attendance and Payslip both need to 
 be stopped. 
 Q: “Approval 
 information does not exist” error coming in employee portal. 
 Answer: If 
 any entry type does not contain any Business Rule or the rule not 
 satisfied for that employee then it will give error like “Approval 
 information does not exist” and the entry will not be saved. 
 Q : How can I enable Aadhar Card No . field in 
 employee master ? 
 Answer: Open 
 Admin Module > Database > Metadata > Select Payroll > 
 Click on Entity name (EmployeeDetails.EmployeeExtraInfo) > Edit 
 > Switch properties tab > Click on AadharNo. > Make Is Required 
 True > Save > Submit. 
 Q : How can I deduct ESIC when salary is 
 more than 21000 per month? 
 Answer: Open setup menu > Localisation > 
 Statutory Master > Select Proper ESI entry > edit the ESI entry 
 > click on “ i” button 
 present in the exact right position of the Template > remove tick 
 mark from statutory. 
 Q : PTAX not deducted. How can I fix this? 
 Answer: There 
 are several possibilities for this. Check all the required points 
 mentioned below: 
 a. 
 In Statutory Master, PTAX should be created for that Company and in 
 the template grid all the required states should be present. 
 b. In CTC, PTAX head should be applicable. 
 c. In deduction Master, PTAX head’s Identification 
 should be Professional Tax. 
 d. In Paystructure definition, calculation 
 type should be on Prorata basis and the calculation will depend upon 
 formula. 
 e. In employee master Is 
 Handicapped should be false. 
 f. State name should be properly filled 
 in Ptax Applicable entity 
 of localization tab which is located in Office master menu. 
 Q : Why am I getting error “Future Year 
 Leave Balance Data Exists: Duplicate Record” while deleting monthly Attendance? 
 Answer: If future year’s leave opening data already 
 exists for that employee then the attendance data cannot be deleted. 
 If you want to delete attendance, first you must delete the leave 
 opening and entry in the future leave year. 
 Q : Leave Head not appearing in Compensatory 
 Leave for adjust. How can I solve? 
 Answer: Leave 
 Head will appear in compensatory leave entry if 
 a. 
 Leave Type set as Compensatory 
 Leave in Leave Master for that Leave Head. 
 b. 
 Leave head has >= 0 
 value in leave opening. 
 Q : How can I enable Sandwich Leave ? 
 Answer: Open 
 Setup menu > Leave Master > Open any leave setup via advance 
 search > Edit > Switch to Extra Info tab > Exclude 
 Holiday Off day checkbox needs to be checked. 
 Q : If an employee takes a leave before 
 or after a holiday/offday I want the holiday to be counted as a leave. 
 How can I do this? 
 Answer: Open 
 Setup menu > Leave Master > Open any leave setup via advance 
 search > Edit > Switch to Extra Info tab > Exclude 
 Holiday Off day checkbox needs to be checked. 
 Q : I am not able to see Manual Attendance 
 menu from mobile app. How can I fix this issue? 
 Answer: Below 
 steps are necessary to see the menu 
 a. In employee Master should have 
 unique Biometric No. 
 for that employee. 
 b . Biometric Editable checkbox should be checked in Other 
 Details page of Employee Master. 
 c. Employee should have that menu 
 right for Manual Attendance (Given through User Rights menu). 
 Q : How can I see my Payslip on my mobile 
 app or Employee Portal? 
 Answer: Payroll > Setup Menu > Configuration 
 > Payslip Show (Employee 
 Needs to be tagged). 
 Q : I want to enable PRQ (Payment Requisition) 
 for Employee Advance and Outside Payslip. How to do that? 
 Answer: Payroll > Setup Menu > Configuration 
 > Payment Requisition Setup > Edit and make true for required 
 menu (Employee advance /Outside Payslip) 
 Q : Leave Head is not appearing when trying 
 to generate Leave Carry Forward. How can I solve this? 
 Answer: Leave 
 Head will appear in Leave Carry Forward if 
 a. Carry Forward 
 Applicable should be true in Leave Master for that leave head. 
 b. Carry Forward Head should be 
 mentioned properly. 
 Q : Provisional 
 employee is Applying for leaves. How can I restrict it? 
 Answer: Availed For Confirmed Employees 
 checkbox should be true in Main 
 Info tab of Leave Master for that leave head. 
 Q : Employee 
 not displayed when trying to generate Salary payment. How can I solve 
 it ? 
 Answer: There are several possibilities 
 to occur such issues. Check below mentioned points 
 a. Salary 
 Journal might be provisional 
 or not generated yet. 
 b. Employee’s 
 salary may be on Hold. 
 c. 
 Employee’s Salary payment may already be done. 
 d. 
 Salary Wise field value 
 may not be accurate. 
 Q : I 
 just applied for a leave but it has not been reflected in Processed Attendance. 
 What is the Issue ? 
 Answer: Run Attendance Process needs to be generated for 
 that employee and for that month before checking Processed Attendance. 
 Q : Cannot 
 find Employee in Monthly Attendance. How Can I find employee in Sequence 
 via Employee Code or Employee Name ? 
 Answer: You can do this via Employee Search Order Criteria 
 option present in Preference setup. Value=1 for employee Name and 
 value=0 for Employee Code wise search. 
 Q : We have generated 
 more than 2000 records in Payslip generation. It’s taking a lot of time 
 to complete. How can I solve this issue ? 
 Answer: You can enable the Queue process for payslip generation. 
 Payroll > Setup menu > Configuration > Preference Setup > 
 Bulk Salary Process Limit > change it to any value which is greater 
 than 0. 
 Q : While 
 doing Salary Payment bank, ledger is not showing. How can I solve it ? 
 Answer: Account Head should be present in Bank Master for 
 the particular entry.

 Amount showing 0 while I try to create leave encashment. How can I solve 
 it? 
 Answer: Below mentioned steps are necessary for doing a leave 
 encashment 
 a. Formula should 
 be properly written in Leave Encashment head of that Paystructure 
 Definition. 
 b. Calculation type should be defined 
 as Prorata Basis. 
 Q : Showing 
 error “Update Leave increment calculation basis of leave head” while trying 
 to save attendance. How can I solve this? 
 Answer: Leave Increment Setup needs to be updated in Leave 
 increment enabled head in Leave Master. 
 Path : Payroll > Setup > Leave Setup 
 > Leave Master > Select Incremental leave heads one by one > 
 Edit > switch to increment tab > Increment days and calculation 
 Basis should be properly mentioned. 
 Q : Showing 
 time range error while saving Outdoor entry. How can I fix this issue? 
 Answer: Entered time is not satisfying the Quarter day master’s 
 time. Please update the Quarter Day Master according to your needs. 
 Path: Payroll > Setup Menu > leave 
 Setup > Quarter Day Master 
 Q : One 
 earning head’s value is present in Payslip but not coming while generating 
 Salary Journal of all employees. How can I solve this? 
 Answer: Check Whether Posting Head is properly 
 tagged for that earning head. 
 Q : Can 
 I add KRA/KPI details into 
 Offer Letter or Appointment Letter? 
 Answer: Yes, KRA/KPI details can be added in Offer/Appointment 
 letter. You just need to add the field in MRT format. 
 P ath: Admin Module > Designer > Document 
 Designer > Choose Application & Entry Type > Add Scope 
 of Work in required format. 
 Q : After 
 editing savings declaration from employee portal, does it go for approval 
 again? 
 Answer: Yes, entry will go for approval each time 
 after edit if the Business Rule exists. 
 Q : If 
 I don’t want Biometric attendance for an employee. What should I do? 
 Answer: Biometric number needs to be removed from 
 employee master for that employee. 
 Q : Can 
 I change Leave encashment value while doing FNF? 
 Answer: If Leave Encashment head is tagged in CTC, 
 employer can process Leave Encashment. While doing FNF employer needs 
 to switch into Leave Encashment tab > Change the number of days 
 of leave encashment > switch to Main Info > Generate Payment. 
 Q : How 
 can I pay bonus to an employee through FNF? 
 Answer: In bonus generation you need to select 
 Payment 
 Type as FNF Payslip. 
 Q : How 
 can I give percentage-based increment? 
 Answer: Through Paystructure Wise CTC menu 
 employer can give Percentage-based increment. 
 Q : Unable

 What could be the issue? 
 Answer: The issue may be due to the Earning Head not being 
 created properly. Please ensure the following steps are followed correctly 
 in the Earning master: 
 a. 
 I dentification should be 
 set to “Other”. 
 b. Method should be defined as 
 Outside Payslip/Voucher. 
 c. 
 Ensure the Reimbursement checkbox is checked or marked True. 
 Q : Leave Balance is showing zero despite setting the increment for 
 that leave head. What could be the issue? 
 Answer: There may be some setup issues. Please 
 ensure the following steps are followed correctly: 
 a. 
 I t is necessary to save 
 monthly attendance for that month to get the leave increment. 
 b. Ensure that the 
 Leave Increment setup is saved in the Increment tab for that specific 
 leave head. 
 c. Increment Days value should 
 be greater than 0 in Increment setup. 
 d. 
 Verify that the Calculation basis via monthly attendance satisfies 
 the requirements of the Increment Days. 
 Q : ESI 
 is not deducted from the Salary. How can I resolve this issue? 
 Answer: This problem may stem from setup issues. 
 Please ensure the following steps are correctly implemented: 
 a. 
 In the Deduction master, 
 ensure that the identification is saved as "ESI CONTRIBUTION," 
 the Method is set as "Payslip," and the Effective From date 
 is set before the present day. 
 b. In Paystructure Definition Formula, 
 the formula for the ESI head should be correctly specified. 
 c. In the Statutory Master, ensure that 
 the ESI template is properly added for the respective Company. 
 d. Check the CTC with respect to ESI 
 formula and verify whether Salary amount crossed 21000 
 or not [when there is Statutory 
 Limit, check in Statutory master] 
 e. 
 Ensure that the ESI Applicable checkbox is true for that employee’s 
 Office master. 
 Q : Paystructure 
 wise posting is setup in Account Posting Category but while generating 
 Salary Journal, the data is not appearing. How can I solve this? 
 Answer: Please verify if the earnings and deductions 
 heads are correctly tagged with the selected Paystructure in the Posting Head Tag menu.

 Answer: If the Mode 
 is set as “Amount to be asked” in Paystructure Definition, the CTC 
 value will not be considered for that head. The payable amount must 
 be generated via variable input transaction screen.
